cycle_002_intake.intake_state: Prepared — candidates are not admitted evidence gates
cycle_002_intake.admission_rule: A candidate becomes a scheduled gate only after human review confirms the exact artifact, official authority, lawful date or observable event trigger, method and denominator contract, affected-record set, capacity, and stop rule.

candidates.title: NERC 2026 Long-Term Reliability Assessment
candidates.exact_artifact: The final NERC 2026 Long-Term Reliability Assessment and its region-level demand, resource, and risk tables.
candidates.event_trigger: NERC publishes the final 2026 LTRA on its official reliability-assessment surface.
candidates.method_requirement: Preserve each assessment area's demand forecast, planning-reserve method, scenario, and season.
candidates.denominator_requirement: Use the named assessment-area peak-demand and resource-capacity denominators; do not aggregate unlike regions.
candidates.stop_rule: Stop if the exact official artifact is absent, preliminary, method-incompatible, denominator-incompatible, or cannot be bound to the named identity; issue no outcome claim from an adjacent artifact.

candidates.title: Queued Up next annual interconnection inventory
candidates.exact_artifact: The next final Queued Up report and downloadable project-level workbook with a stated data cutoff.
candidates.event_trigger: Berkeley Lab publishes the next Queued Up annual report and workbook on its official Electricity Markets & Policy surface.
candidates.method_requirement: Retain project-status taxonomy, queue vintage, technology grouping, and treatment of hybrid projects.
candidates.denominator_requirement: Report projects and nameplate capacity separately; never convert queued capacity into completed capacity.
candidates.stop_rule: Stop if the exact official artifact is absent, preliminary, method-incompatible, denominator-incompatible, or cannot be bound to the named identity; issue no outcome claim from an adjacent artifact.

candidates.title: United States data-center electricity-use update
candidates.primary_authority: United States Department of Energy and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
candidates.exact_artifact: A final DOE or Berkeley Lab update with observed national data-center electricity use, analysis year, model version, and scenario bounds.
candidates.event_trigger: DOE or Berkeley Lab publishes a successor national data-center energy-use report or official data release.
candidates.method_requirement: Separate observed baseline, model estimate, and forecast scenario and retain model-version lineage.
candidates.denominator_requirement: Use national electricity consumption for the same year and method when reporting a share.
candidates.stop_rule: Stop if the exact official artifact is absent, preliminary, method-incompatible, denominator-incompatible, or cannot be bound to the named identity; issue no outcome claim from an adjacent artifact.

candidates.title: Post-2026 Colorado River operations final decision
candidates.exact_artifact: The signed Post-2026 Colorado River Operations Record of Decision and final operating alternative tables.
candidates.event_trigger: The Bureau of Reclamation publishes the signed Record of Decision on its official Post-2026 operations surface.
candidates.method_requirement: Bind every operating claim to the selected alternative, hydrologic condition, rule, and effective period.
candidates.denominator_requirement: Retain acre-feet, reservoir elevation, basin, water year, and allocation identity exactly.
candidates.stop_rule: Stop if the exact official artifact is absent, preliminary, method-incompatible, denominator-incompatible, or cannot be bound to the named identity; issue no outcome claim from an adjacent artifact.

candidates.title: WIFIA fiscal-year 2026 portfolio outcomes

candidates.event_trigger: EPA publishes the final fiscal-year 2026 WIFIA annual report on its official program-results surface.
candidates.method_requirement: Separate closed loans, financed projects, construction progress, and reported outcomes by report vintage.
candidates.denominator_requirement: Use EPA's stated project and population denominators without treating financing value as delivered infrastructure.
candidates.stop_rule: Stop if the exact official artifact is absent, preliminary, method-incompatible, denominator-incompatible, or cannot be bound to the named identity; issue no outcome claim from an adjacent artifact.

publication_boundaries: The closeout shell is not a Cycle 001 closure receipt.
A Cycle 002 candidate is not a source check, scheduled gate, evidence decision, or publication outcome.
Future dates, source checks, decisions, receipts, propagation proofs, Git publication, deployment, and v1 promotion remain null or Held.
Candidate intake reuses official source identities but does not claim that a successor artifact exists.
